name: Lagunas Chirifo from Puerto Río Tranquilo (one night)
note: Unmarked route from the edge of Río Tranquilo to a chain of lagoons; camp above the third lagoon. No water on the climb; GPS needed; free. Coordinates approximate (verify against the Wikiexplora GPX).

name: Valle Miller to base camp (one night)
note: Remote valley via Bahía Murta, X-731 and 17 km gravel from Puerto Sánchez; braided ford; gates through grazing land; local guides recommended. Coordinates rough.

name: Lagunilla del Rodado (Valle Exploradores)
note: Off-trail climb up a stream bed from the km 26.5 pullout on X-728 to a small lake. Free. Wikiexplora route.
